meta.description: Experiment ledger — single source of truth. One record per dissertation-citable experiment. Edit THIS file (editorial fields: section/figure/headline/status/priority); build_ledger.py renders experiment_ledger.csv + EXPERIMENT_LEDGER.md and refreshes status/live-metrics from the master tables when they are reachable (Drive on Colab, or --results-root).

status_legend.done: ran to completion; results in a master table
status_legend.partial: ran on a subset (datasets/optimizers) of the intended scope
status_legend.needs-rerun: ran but the result is suspect / superseded

experiments.title: Base optimizer × COSGD

experiments.title: Buffer size K
